_doc: Azalia — the South Carolina borderlands store manager and Todd's boss. Genuinely kind, warm, and supportive to every face in the building — and profoundly unable to let any consequence stick: every write-up her shop manager draws gets kindly unmade, which is exactly how a wheel almost comes off in the back lot. The kindness was never a lie; it just could never hold anyone. Dialogue-only.
name: Azalia
title: Store Manager, The Borderlands
samplePhrase: The people in this building are the reason I stay in this job.
